children: Overview
China curtain wall maker's interim revenue rose yr/yr for six months ended June 2026
Adjusted gross profit margin improved to 27.3% from 23.3% yr/yr
Profit attributable to shareholders and EPS both declined yr/yr
Outlook
Board reallocates about HK$290 mln of unutilised IPO proceeds from production-capacity expansion to R&D
Result Drivers
DOMESTIC PROJECT DELIVERIES – Domestic revenue rose 61.0% to RMB650.6 mln as projects entered concentrated delivery, supported by higher-credit-quality work
PROJECT COST CONTROL – Adjusted gross margin rose to 27.3% from 23.3%, driven by tighter project cost control and an improved credit-risk profile
FX AND INTEREST COSTS – Net finance swung to an RMB120.4 mln expense from RMB70.3 mln income due to exchange losses and higher loan interest
